title: FTC sues Hims & Hers for allegedly sharing patients’ medical data with advertisers Meta and Snap
summary: The FTC has filed a lawsuit against Hims & Hers for allegedly using website trackers to share patients' medical data with advertisers Meta and Snap without proper consent, raising privacy concerns in the telehealth sector.
content: The U.S. federal consumer watchdog said Hims & Hers, which prescribes for sexual wellness and mental health conditions, used website trackers to share customers' information with advertisers.

zh.title: FTC起诉Hims & Hers涉嫌与广告商Meta和Snap分享患者医疗数据
zh.summary: FTC对Hims & Hers提起诉讼，指控其涉嫌使用网站追踪器在未经适当同意的情况下与广告商Meta和Snap分享患者医疗数据，引发了远程医疗部门的隐私问题。

title: Zoox clears final federal hurdle to launch paid robotaxi service
summary: Amazon's autonomous vehicle subsidiary Zoox has received federal regulatory approval to operate and charge customers for rides in its custom-built robotaxis, marking a major milestone in commercial autonomous vehicle deployment.
content: Federal safety regulators have given Zoox a temporary exemption that will allow the Amazon-owned autonomous vehicle technology company to charge customers for rides in its custom-built robotaxi.

zh.title: Zoox获得联邦批准，启动付费机器人出租车服务
zh.summary: 亚马逊的自动驾驶汽车子公司Zoox已获得联邦监管部门批准，可以运营其定制机器人出租车并向乘客收费，这标志着商业自动驾驶汽车部署的一个重要里程碑。

title: Spotify Running Mode helps match tunes to tempo
summary: Spotify's new AI-powered Running Mode feature uses BPM matching and personalization to help Premium users quickly build workout playlists aligned with their fitness goals and music preferences.
content:
An easier way to find the right beats for your BPM. | Image: Spotify	

Spotify has introduced a new Running Mode feature that makes it easier to curate playlists around your workout goals, music tastes, and desired beats per minute (BPM). The aim is to help you "spend less time hunting for the right music and more time moving," according to Spotify's announcement, providing customizable running presets and optional coaching features.
Running Mode is an AI-powered experience that builds on personalization capabilities that were introduced with Prompted Playlists last year, with Spotify finding that fitness-based prompts have been some of the most popular uses for that feature. It requires a Premium subscription …

title: Amazon’s short story collections are one of the best reasons to own a Kindle
summary: Amazon's curated short story collections on Kindle provide compelling value for e-reader owners, offering accessibility and convenience that competes with the satisfaction of physical book collecting.
content:
Over the last few years, I've gradually shifted away from ebooks. It's been part of a general return to physical media, an attempt to create a deeper sense of ownership over the art I love and collect. A Kindle is obviously more convenient than a paperback: It's tiny, holds a huge library, and you can purchase new books instantly. But, much like with retro game cartridges, I find there's a deeper connection formed with a book dug out of a stack in a used book shop versus simply choosing the next thing in a series from a menu on an e-reader. But I haven't completely given up on my Kindle, and there's one big reason - actually, there are lots  …

title: A second lens makes DJI’s Osmo Pocket 4P my new favorite video camera
summary: DJI's Osmo Pocket 4P adds a 3x telephoto lens to the Osmo Pocket 4, offering improved video capabilities at a competitive price compared to rival Insta360's Luna Ultra, making it an excellent choice for most prospective buyers.
content:
Like other recent DJI products, the Pocket 4P won’t launch in the US.	

DJI's Osmo Pocket 4P is a pretty simple proposition: an Osmo Pocket 4 with a second camera lens slapped inside. But is that extra lens worth the added size, weight, and cost relative to the regular Pocket 4? And how does it compare to the only rival on the market, Insta360's dual-lens Luna Ultra? 
It depends on what you're filming. But I think most prospective buyers would get plenty of use out of the 4P's 3x telephoto lens, and its quality is certainly impressive. Meanwhile, DJI has managed to undercut Insta360 on price while at least matching it on quality. For most, this will be the better buy, though the Luna Ultra has one major advanta …

title: SwitchBot makes a better fan
summary: SwitchBot's new Battery Circulator Fan 2 Pro is a portable, battery-powered smart fan featuring extended runtime, increased airflow, native Matter support, and quiet operation, priced at $119.99 for mid-sized rooms and outdoor use.
content:
SwitchBot Battery Circulator Fan 2 Pro is smart, powerful, and portable. | Image: SwitchBot	

I was already a big fan of SwitchBot's big circulator fan I recently reviewed, and now we're getting the SwitchBot Battery Circulator Fan 2 Pro. Priced at $119.99, it ditches the height-adjustable stand but increases battery life, throw distance, and wind speed while adding native Matter-over-Wi-Fi, allowing it to join your smart home without needing a separate SwitchBot Hub.

title: Microsoft is openly competing with OpenAI, Anthropic more than ever
